recipe.name: Tarri Pohe
steps: Soak the black chickpeas in plenty of water for 8–12 hours, then drain. Put them in a pressure cooker with 650 ml of the measured fresh water and 4 g salt. Cook until completely tender, about 20–25 minutes at pressure, allowing the pressure to release naturally. Keep both the chickpeas and their cooking liquid.

While the chickpeas cook, toast the dry coconut and sesame seeds in a dry pan over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes. Blend them with half the onion, the ginger, garlic, half the green chilli, red chilli powder, ground coriander and a little of the chickpea liquid into a smooth, pourable paste.

Heat 35 ml oil in a deep pan. Add half the cumin seeds, then the remaining onion; cook for 5–6 minutes until golden. Add the spice paste and cook for 7–8 minutes, stirring often, until the raw smell fades and oil glistens at the edges. Add the chopped tomato, turmeric and garam masala; cook for 4 minutes until the tomato softens.

Add the tender chickpeas and their liquid. Pour in the remaining measured water and simmer for 12–15 minutes, until the gravy is thin enough to ladle over poha but tastes fully cooked. Season with another 4 g salt; if it reduces too far, add a small splash of hot water.

Rinse the poha briefly in a sieve and drain for 8–10 minutes; the flakes should soften without turning mushy. Heat the remaining oil in a wide pan and fry the peanuts until crisp. Add mustard seeds, remaining cumin, diced potato, remaining green chilli and curry leaves. Cook for 8–10 minutes until the potato is tender, then fold in the poha, 4 g salt and half the coriander. Cover and steam over low heat for 3 minutes.

Divide the hot poha among four bowls. Ladle the hot chickpea tarri over each portion, then finish with the remaining coriander, fine sev and a little lemon juice. Serve immediately so the poha stays fluffy and the sev remains crisp.
tips: Keep the tarri thinner than a typical chana curry so it moistens the poha without burying its texture. Increase the chilli only after tasting the finished gravy.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak the black chickpeas for 8–12 hours before cooking.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Soak the black chickpeas in plenty of wa: काले चनों को भरपूर पानी में 8–12 घंटे भिगोकर पानी निकाल दें। उन्हें प्रेशर कुकर में नापे हुए ताज़े पानी में से 650 मिली पानी और 4 ग्राम नमक के साथ डालें। दबाव बनने के बाद लगभग 20–25 मिनट, पूरी तरह नरम होने तक पकाएँ। दबाव अपने आप उतरने दें और चने तथा उनका पकाने वाला पानी दोनों बचाकर रखें।
hi.While the chickpeas cook, toast the dry: चना पकते समय सूखे नारियल और सफेद तिल को सूखी कड़ाही में मध्यम-धीमी आँच पर 2–3 मिनट भूनें। इन्हें आधे प्याज, अदरक, लहसुन, आधी हरी मिर्च, लाल मिर्च पाउडर, धनिया पाउडर और चने के थोड़े पानी के साथ पीसकर चिकना, बहने लायक पेस्ट बनाएँ।
hi.Heat 35 ml oil in a deep pan. Add half t: गहरे पैन में 35 मिली तेल गरम करें। आधा जीरा डालें, फिर बचा प्याज डालकर 5–6 मिनट सुनहरा होने तक पकाएँ। मसाले का पेस्ट मिलाकर 7–8 मिनट चलाते हुए पकाएँ, जब तक कच्ची गंध खत्म हो और किनारों पर तेल दिखे। कटा टमाटर, हल्दी और गरम मसाला डालें; टमाटर नरम होने तक लगभग 4 मिनट पकाएँ।
hi.Add the tender chickpeas and their liqui: पके चने उनके पानी सहित डालें। बचा नापा हुआ पानी मिलाएँ और 12–15 मिनट धीमी आँच पर पकाएँ। तरी इतनी पतली हो कि पोहे पर डाली जा सके, लेकिन मसाला अच्छी तरह पका हुआ लगे। और 4 ग्राम नमक डालें; बहुत गाढ़ी हो जाए तो थोड़ा गरम पानी मिलाएँ।
hi.Rinse the poha briefly in a sieve and dr: पोहे को छलनी में जल्दी से धोकर 8–10 मिनट छानें; दाने नरम हों पर लुगदी न बनें। चौड़ी कड़ाही में बचा तेल गरम करके मूंगफली कुरकुरी तलें। राई, बचा जीरा, छोटे कटे आलू, बची हरी मिर्च और कड़ी पत्ते डालें। आलू नरम होने तक 8–10 मिनट पकाएँ, फिर पोहा, 4 ग्राम नमक और आधा हरा धनिया हल्के हाथ से मिलाएँ। ढककर धीमी आँच पर 3 मिनट भाप में पकाएँ।
hi.Divide the hot poha among four bowls. La: गरम पोहा चार कटोरियों में बाँटें। हर हिस्से पर गरम चने की तरी डालें और ऊपर से बचा हरा धनिया, बारीक सेव और थोड़ा नींबू रस डालें। तुरंत परोसें ताकि पोहा फूला हुआ और सेव कुरकुरी रहे।
hi.Keep the tarri thinner than a typical ch: तरी को सामान्य चना करी से पतला रखें ताकि पोहा नम हो, पर उसकी बनावट बनी रहे। तैयार तरी चखने के बाद ही मिर्च बढ़ाएँ।
hi.Soak the black chickpeas for 8–12 hours: पकाने से पहले काले चने 8–12 घंटे भिगोएँ।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Soak the black chickpeas in plenty of wa: કાળા ચણાને પુષ્કળ પાણીમાં 8–12 કલાક પલાળી પાણી કાઢી નાખો. પ્રેશર કૂકરમાં માપેલા તાજા પાણીમાંથી 650 મિલી પાણી અને 4 ગ્રામ મીઠા સાથે ચણા નાખો. દબાણ આવ્યા પછી આશરે 20–25 મિનિટ સંપૂર્ણ નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાંધો. દબાણ આપોઆપ ઊતરે પછી ચણા અને તેમનું રાંધેલું પાણી બંને સાચવો.
gu.While the chickpeas cook, toast the dry: ચણા રંધાય ત્યાં સુધી સૂકું નાળિયેર અને સફેદ તલને સૂકી કડાઈમાં મધ્યમથી ધીમા તાપે 2–3 મિનિટ શેકો. અડધી ડુંગળી, આદુ, લસણ, અડધું લીલું મરચું, લાલ મરચું પાઉડર, ધાણા પાઉડર અને ચણાના થોડા પાણી સાથે પીસીને સરસ, રેડી શકાય તેવી પેસ્ટ બનાવો.
gu.Heat 35 ml oil in a deep pan. Add half t: ઊંડી કડાઈમાં 35 મિલી તેલ ગરમ કરો. અડધું જીરું નાખો, પછી બાકી ડુંગળી નાખીને 5–6 મિનિટ સોનેરી થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાંધો. મસાલાની પેસ્ટ ઉમેરી 7–8 મિનિટ વારંવાર હલાવતા રાંધો, કાચી વાસ જતી રહે અને કિનારે તેલ દેખાય ત્યાં સુધી. સમારેલાં ટામેટાં, હળદર અને ગરમ મસાલો નાખો; ટામેટાં નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી આશરે 4 મિનિટ રાંધો.
gu.Add the tender chickpeas and their liqui: રાંધેલા ચણા તેમનાં પાણી સાથે નાખો. બાકીનું માપેલું પાણી ઉમેરી 12–15 મિનિટ ધીમે ઉકાળો. તરી એટલી પાતળી રાખો કે પૌંઆ પર રેડી શકાય, પણ મસાલો પૂરો રંધાયેલો લાગે. બીજા 4 ગ્રામ મીઠું નાખો; વધારે ઘટ્ટ થઈ જાય તો થોડું ગરમ પાણી ઉમેરો.
gu.Rinse the poha briefly in a sieve and dr: પૌંઆને ચાળણીમાં ઝડપથી ધોઈ 8–10 મિનિટ નિતારો; દાણા નરમ થાય પણ ચીકણા ન થાય. પહોળી કડાઈમાં બાકી તેલ ગરમ કરી મગફળી કરકરી શેકો. રાઈ, બાકી જીરું, નાના સમારેલા બટાકા, બાકી લીલું મરચું અને મીઠા લીમડાના પાન નાખો. બટાકા નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી 8–10 મિનિટ રાંધો, પછી પૌંઆ, 4 ગ્રામ મીઠું અને અડધી કોથમીર હળવે હાથે ભેળવો. ઢાંકીને ધીમા તાપે 3 મિનિટ બાફો.
gu.Divide the hot poha among four bowls. La: ગરમ પૌંઆ ચાર વાટકામાં વહેંચો. દરેક પર ગરમ ચણાની તરી રેડો અને બાકી કોથમીર, ઝીણી સેવ તથા થોડો લીંબુનો રસ નાખો. તરત પીરસો જેથી પૌંઆ ફૂલેલા અને સેવ કરકરી રહે.
gu.Keep the tarri thinner than a typical ch: તરીને સામાન્ય ચણા કરી કરતાં પાતળી રાખો જેથી પૌંઆ ભીના થાય પણ તેમની રચના જળવાય. તૈયાર તરી ચાખ્યા પછી જ મરચું વધારો.
gu.Soak the black chickpeas for 8–12 hours: રાંધતાં પહેલાં કાળા ચણાને 8–12 કલાક પલાળો.

recipe.name: Komal Saul
steps: Check that the rice is genuine Assamese komol saul (soft rice), which softens in room-temperature water; ordinary raw rice cannot safely be served this way. Pick out any debris, then rinse the grains gently in a sieve until the water is mostly clear.

Put the rinsed soft rice in a clean bowl with the measured drinking water. Cover and soak for 30–45 minutes, or for the time on the package, until a grain is tender all the way through and has no hard centre. Drain thoroughly; do not boil this special rice.
Whisk the plain curd briefly until smooth. Break the jaggery into small pieces and slice the bananas just before serving so they stay fresh. Divide the drained soft rice evenly among four bowls.

Spoon the curd over each bowl, add banana slices and sprinkle the jaggery on top. Serve immediately while cool. If holding for later, keep the soaked rice and curd refrigerated separately and assemble just before eating.
tips: Komol saul is a specific soft-rice variety, not ordinary rice or flattened poha. Buy a clearly labelled product and follow its soaking guidance.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak genuine komol saul soft rice for 30–45 minutes; follow the producer's directions if they differ.

hi.Check that the rice is genuine Assamese: जाँचें कि चावल असली असमिया कोमल साउल है, जो सामान्य तापमान के पानी में नरम होता है; साधारण कच्चा चावल इस तरह परोसना सुरक्षित नहीं है। कंकड़ आदि निकालें, फिर छलनी में धीरे-धीरे धोएँ जब तक पानी लगभग साफ न हो जाए।
hi.Put the rinsed soft rice in a clean bowl: धुले नरम चावल को साफ कटोरे में नापे हुए पीने के पानी के साथ रखें। ढककर 30–45 मिनट, या पैकेट पर बताए समय तक भिगोएँ। दाना अंदर तक नरम हो और बीच में कड़ापन न रहे। अच्छी तरह छानें; इस विशेष चावल को उबालें नहीं।
hi.Whisk the plain curd briefly until smoot: सादा दही हल्का फेंटकर चिकना करें। गुड़ के छोटे टुकड़े करें और केले परोसने से ठीक पहले काटें ताकि ताज़े रहें। छने नरम चावल चार कटोरियों में बराबर बाँटें।
hi.Spoon the curd over each bowl, add banan: हर कटोरी में दही डालें, केले के टुकड़े रखें और ऊपर से गुड़ छिड़कें। ठंडा रहते ही परोसें। बाद में परोसना हो तो भीगे चावल और दही अलग-अलग फ्रिज में रखें और खाने से ठीक पहले मिलाएँ।

hi.Soak genuine komol saul soft rice for 30: असली कोमल साउल नरम चावल 30–45 मिनट भिगोएँ; पैकेट पर अलग समय दिया हो तो उसका पालन करें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Check that the rice is genuine Assamese: ખાતરી કરો કે ચોખા અસલી આસામી કોમોલ સાઉલ છે, જે ઓરડાના તાપમાનના પાણીમાં નરમ થાય છે; સામાન્ય કાચા ચોખા આ રીતે પીરસવા સલામત નથી. કાંકરા વગેરે કાઢીને ચાળણીમાં હળવેથી ધોવો, પાણી લગભગ સ્વચ્છ નીકળે ત્યાં સુધી.
gu.Put the rinsed soft rice in a clean bowl: ધોયેલા નરમ ચોખાને સ્વચ્છ વાટકામાં માપેલા પીવાના પાણી સાથે મૂકો. ઢાંકીને 30–45 મિનિટ, અથવા પેકેટ પર જણાવેલા સમય સુધી પલાળો. દાણા અંદર સુધી નરમ થાય અને મધ્યમાં કઠણ ન રહે. સારી રીતે નિતારો; આ ખાસ ચોખાને ઉકાળો નહીં.
gu.Whisk the plain curd briefly until smoot: સાદું દહીં થોડું ફેંટીને સરસ કરો. ગોળના નાના ટુકડા કરો અને કેળાં પીરસતાં પહેલાં જ કાપો જેથી તાજાં રહે. નિતારેલા નરમ ચોખા ચાર વાટકામાં સરખા વહેંચો.
gu.Spoon the curd over each bowl, add banan: દરેક વાટકામાં દહીં નાખો, કેળાની કતરણ મૂકો અને ઉપર ગોળ છાંટો. ઠંડું હોય ત્યારે તરત પીરસો. પછી પીરસવું હોય તો પલાળેલા ચોખા અને દહીં અલગ-અલગ ફ્રિજમાં રાખો અને ખાતાં પહેલાં ભેળવો.
gu.Komol saul is a specific soft-rice varie: કોમોલ સાઉલ ખાસ નરમ ચોખાની જાત છે, સામાન્ય ચોખા કે પૌંઆ નહીં. સ્પષ્ટ લેબલવાળું ઉત્પાદન લો અને પલાળવાની તેની સૂચના અનુસરો.
gu.Soak genuine komol saul soft rice for 30: અસલી કોમોલ સાઉલ નરમ ચોખાને 30–45 મિનિટ પલાળો; પેકેટ પર જુદી સૂચના હોય તો તે અનુસરો.

recipe.name: Uggani
steps: Pulse the roasted chickpeas and dry coconut to a fine powder and set aside. Pick over the puffed rice so no hard bits remain. Have the chopped onion, chilli and coriander ready before wetting the rice; it softens quickly.

Pour the measured water into a large bowl, dip the puffed rice in it for only 1–2 minutes, then lift it out by handfuls and squeeze gently to remove excess water. Put the damp grains in a sieve. They should feel soft but remain separate, not soggy.

Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds; when they pop, add cumin and split urad dal. Stir until the dal turns light gold, then add curry leaves and green chilli for a few seconds. Add the onion and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened but not browned.

Stir in turmeric and the drained puffed rice. Sprinkle over the chickpea-coconut powder and salt, then fold gently for 1–2 minutes so the yellow seasoning coats the grains without crushing them. Turn off the heat as soon as everything is hot.
Fold in the roasted peanuts and lemon juice. Divide among four bowls and finish with chopped coriander. Serve warm immediately; holding it covered for long makes the puffed rice heavy.
tips: The short soak and firm squeeze matter more than extra cooking. Do not substitute raw chana flour for roasted chickpea powder.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Pulse the roasted chickpeas and dry coco: भुने चने और सूखे नारियल को पीसकर महीन चूर्ण बनाएँ और अलग रखें। मुरमुरों में से कड़े टुकड़े निकाल दें। चावल भिगोने से पहले कटे प्याज, मिर्च और धनिया तैयार रखें, क्योंकि मुरमुरे जल्दी नरम होते हैं।
hi.Pour the measured water into a large bow: नापा हुआ पानी बड़े कटोरे में डालें। मुरमुरे सिर्फ 1–2 मिनट उसमें डुबोएँ, फिर मुट्ठी-मुट्ठी निकालकर अतिरिक्त पानी हल्के से निचोड़ें। नम दाने छलनी में रखें। वे नरम पर अलग-अलग होने चाहिए, गीली लुगदी नहीं।
hi.Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium h: चौड़े पैन में मध्यम आँच पर तेल गरम करें। राई चटकने पर जीरा और उड़द दाल डालें। दाल हल्की सुनहरी होने तक चलाएँ, फिर कड़ी पत्ते और हरी मिर्च कुछ सेकंड भूनें। प्याज डालकर 5–6 मिनट नरम होने तक पकाएँ, भूरा न करें।
hi.Stir in turmeric and the drained puffed: हल्दी और छने मुरमुरे मिलाएँ। ऊपर से चना-नारियल चूर्ण और नमक डालकर 1–2 मिनट हल्के हाथ से पलटें, ताकि पीला मसाला दानों पर लगे और वे टूटें नहीं। सब गरम होते ही आँच बंद करें।
hi.Fold in the roasted peanuts and lemon ju: भुनी मूंगफली और नींबू का रस मिलाएँ। चार कटोरियों में बाँटकर कटा हरा धनिया डालें। तुरंत गरम परोसें; देर तक ढककर रखने से मुरमुरे भारी हो जाते हैं।
hi.The short soak and firm squeeze matter m: थोड़ी देर भिगोना और पानी अच्छी तरह निचोड़ना अतिरिक्त पकाने से ज्यादा जरूरी है। भुने चने के चूर्ण की जगह कच्चा बेसन न डालें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Pulse the roasted chickpeas and dry coco: શેકેલા ચણા અને સૂકા નાળિયેરનો ઝીણો ભૂકો બનાવી અલગ રાખો. મમરામાંથી કઠણ ટુકડા વીણી કાઢો. મમરા ભીંજવતાં પહેલાં સમારેલી ડુંગળી, મરચાં અને કોથમીર તૈયાર રાખો, કારણ કે મમરા જલદી નરમ થાય છે.
gu.Pour the measured water into a large bow: માપેલું પાણી મોટા વાસણમાં લો. મમરા ફક્ત 1–2 મિનિટ તેમાં બોળો, પછી મુઠ્ઠી-મુઠ્ઠી કાઢીને વધારાનું પાણી હળવેથી નીચોવો. ભીના દાણા ચાળણીમાં મૂકો. તે નરમ પણ છૂટા હોવા જોઈએ, ચીકણા નહીં.
gu.Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium h: પહોળી કડાઈમાં મધ્યમ તાપે તેલ ગરમ કરો. રાઈ તતડે પછી જીરું અને ફાડેલી અડદની દાળ નાખો. દાળ આછા સોનેરી રંગની થાય ત્યાં સુધી હલાવો, પછી મીઠા લીમડાના પાન અને લીલું મરચું થોડી સેકંડ શેકો. ડુંગળી નાખીને 5–6 મિનિટ નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાંધો, ભૂરું ન કરો.
gu.Stir in turmeric and the drained puffed: હળદર અને નિતારેલા મમરા ભેળવો. ઉપરથી ચણા-નાળિયેરનો ભૂકો અને મીઠું નાખીને 1–2 મિનિટ હળવે હાથે ફેરવો જેથી પીળો મસાલો દાણાને ચોંટે પણ દાણા તૂટે નહીં. બધું ગરમ થાય એટલે તાપ બંધ કરો.
gu.Fold in the roasted peanuts and lemon ju: શેકેલી મગફળી અને લીંબુનો રસ ભેળવો. ચાર વાટકામાં વહેંચી સમારેલી કોથમીર નાખો. તરત ગરમ પીરસો; લાંબો સમય ઢાંકી રાખવાથી મમરા ભારે બને છે.
gu.The short soak and firm squeeze matter m: ટૂંકું પલાળવું અને પાણી સારી રીતે નીચોવવું વધારાના રાંધવા કરતાં વધુ જરૂરી છે. શેકેલા ચણાના ભૂકાને બદલે કાચો ચણાનો લોટ ન વાપરો.

recipe.name: Coconut Dosa
steps: Rinse the rice, poha and fenugreek separately, then combine in a bowl with the measured water. Soak for 4–5 hours until a rice grain breaks easily when pressed. Reserve the soaking water.
Drain, keeping the water. Grind the rice mixture in batches with the fresh coconut, adding only enough reserved water to make a smooth, thick batter that falls slowly from a ladle.

Pour the batter into a roomy clean vessel, cover loosely and leave in a warm place for 10–12 hours. It should rise, show small bubbles and smell pleasantly fermented. Discard batter with an off smell.

Gently mix in the salt. Heat a seasoned flat griddle over medium heat and brush with a little of the measured oil. Pour a small ladle of batter into a thick circle about 12 cm across; do not spread thin.

Drizzle oil around the edge, cover and cook for 2–3 minutes until the top is set and the underside has light golden spots. Lift with a spatula; flipping is unnecessary if the top is fully cooked. Repeat with the remaining batter and oil.
Serve two small dosas per person while warm. Cool any leftover batter promptly, refrigerate it in a covered container and stir gently before the next use.
tips: Fresh coconut and a thick batter give this dosa its soft, porous texture. The photo includes coconut chutney only as an optional serving suggestion.

gu.Fresh coconut and a thick batter give th: તાજું નાળિયેર અને ઘટ્ટ ખીરું ઢોસાને નરમ તથા છિદ્રાળુ બનાવે છે. ફોટામાં નાળિયેરની ચટણી ફક્ત વૈકલ્પિક પીરસવાનો વિચાર છે.
gu.Soak rice and poha for 4–5 hours, then f: ચોખા અને પૌંઆને 4–5 કલાક પલાળો, પછી ખીરાને ગરમ જગ્યાએ 10–12 કલાક આથો આવવા દો.

recipe.name: Bella Dosa
steps: Rinse the rice and chana dal until the water runs mostly clear. Put them in a deep bowl with 350 ml of the measured water and soak for 5–6 hours, until both grains are soft enough to grind. Keep the soaking liquid.

Drain, reserving the liquid. Grind the soaked rice and dal with fresh coconut and cardamom to a smooth batter. Add the reserved liquid gradually so the batter pours from a ladle but is thicker than a thin crepe batter.

Break up the jaggery and dissolve it in the remaining 100 ml measured water over low heat. Strain out grit, cool until just warm, then stir it into the batter. Rest the batter for 10 minutes and check that it still pours in a thick ribbon.

Heat a flat griddle over medium-low heat and rub with a little measured ghee. Pour a small ladle of batter and spread gently to a circle about 12 cm wide. Drizzle a little more ghee around the edge and cook for 2–3 minutes until the underside is golden and the top has set.

Lift the dosa carefully; flip for about 30 seconds only if the top remains damp. Repeat with the remaining batter and ghee, lowering the heat if jaggery darkens too quickly. Serve two warm sweet dosas per person.
tips: Jaggery browns faster than plain dosa batter, so keep the pan at medium-low heat. The coconut is ground into the batter; no sweet filling is required.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak the rice and chana dal for 5–6 hours.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Rinse the rice and chana dal until the w: चावल और चना दाल को पानी लगभग साफ होने तक धोएँ। गहरे कटोरे में नापे हुए पानी में से 350 मिली पानी डालकर 5–6 घंटे भिगोएँ, जब तक दोनों दाने पीसने लायक नरम हों। भिगोने वाला पानी बचाकर रखें।
hi.Drain, reserving the liquid. Grind the s: भीगा मिश्रण छानकर पानी बचाएँ। चावल और दाल को ताज़े नारियल और इलायची के साथ चिकना पीसें। बचा पानी धीरे-धीरे मिलाएँ ताकि घोल करछुल से डले, लेकिन पतली क्रेप के घोल से गाढ़ा रहे।
hi.Break up the jaggery and dissolve it in: गुड़ तोड़कर बचे 100 मिली नापे हुए पानी में धीमी आँच पर घोलें। किरकिरापन छानें, हल्का गरम रहने तक ठंडा करें, फिर घोल में मिलाएँ। घोल 10 मिनट रखें और देखें कि वह मोटी धार में गिरता हो।
hi.Heat a flat griddle over medium-low heat: चपटा तवा मध्यम-धीमी आँच पर गरम करके थोड़ा नापा घी लगाएँ। छोटी करछुल घोल डालकर लगभग 12 सेमी का गोल डोसा हल्के से फैलाएँ। किनारे पर थोड़ा और घी डालकर 2–3 मिनट पकाएँ, नीचे सुनहरा हो और ऊपर से पक जाए तब तक।
hi.Lift the dosa carefully; flip for about: डोसा सावधानी से उठाएँ; ऊपर नम हो तो ही पलटकर लगभग 30 सेकंड पकाएँ। बचे घोल और घी से इसी तरह बनाएँ, गुड़ जल्दी गहरा होने लगे तो आँच घटाएँ। प्रति व्यक्ति दो गरम मीठे डोसे परोसें।
hi.Jaggery browns faster than plain dosa ba: गुड़ वाला घोल सामान्य डोसे से जल्दी भूरा होता है, इसलिए तवा मध्यम-धीमी आँच पर रखें। नारियल घोल में पिसता है; अलग मीठी भराई जरूरी नहीं।
hi.Soak the rice and chana dal for 5–6 hour: चावल और चना दाल 5–6 घंटे भिगोएँ।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Rinse the rice and chana dal until the w: ચોખા અને ચણાની દાળનું પાણી લગભગ સ્વચ્છ થાય ત્યાં સુધી ધોવો. ઊંડી વાટકામાં માપેલા પાણીમાંથી 350 મિલી પાણી સાથે 5–6 કલાક પલાળો, બંને દાણા પીસી શકાય એટલા નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી. પલાળેલું પાણી સાચવો.
gu.Drain, reserving the liquid. Grind the s: પલાળેલું મિશ્રણ નિતારી પાણી સાચવો. ચોખા અને દાળને તાજા નાળિયેર તથા એલચી સાથે સરસ પીસો. સાચવેલું પાણી ધીમે-ધીમે ઉમેરો જેથી ખીરું ચમચીમાંથી રેડી શકાય, પણ પાતળી ક્રેપના ખીરા કરતાં ઘટ્ટ રહે.
gu.Break up the jaggery and dissolve it in: ગોળના ટુકડા કરીને બાકી 100 મિલી માપેલા પાણીમાં ધીમા તાપે ઓગાળો. કચરો ગાળી કાઢો, થોડું ગરમ રહે ત્યાં સુધી ઠંડું કરો અને ખીરામાં ભેળવો. 10 મિનિટ રાખી જુઓ કે ખીરું જાડી ધારામાં પડે.
gu.Heat a flat griddle over medium-low heat: સપાટ તવો મધ્યમથી ધીમા તાપે ગરમ કરી થોડું માપેલું ઘી લગાવો. નાનો ચમચો ખીરું રેડી આશરે 12 સેમીનો ગોળ ઢોસો હળવેથી ફેલાવો. કિનારે થોડું ઘી નાખી 2–3 મિનિટ શેકો, નીચે સોનેરી અને ઉપરથી શેકાઈ જાય ત્યાં સુધી.
gu.Lift the dosa carefully; flip for about: ઢોસો કાળજીથી ઊંચકો; ઉપર ભીનાશ હોય તો જ ફેરવી આશરે 30 સેકંડ શેકો. બાકી ખીરું અને ઘીથી આમ જ બનાવો; ગોળ ઝડપથી ઘેરો થાય તો તાપ ઘટાડો. વ્યક્તિ દીઠ બે ગરમ મીઠા ઢોસા પીરસો.
gu.Jaggery browns faster than plain dosa ba: ગોળવાળું ખીરું સામાન્ય ઢોસા કરતાં વહેલું ભૂરું થાય છે, તેથી તવો મધ્યમથી ધીમા તાપે રાખો. નાળિયેર ખીરામાં પીસાય છે; અલગ મીઠો ભરાવો જરૂરી નથી.
gu.Soak the rice and chana dal for 5–6 hour: ચોખા અને ચણાની દાળ 5–6 કલાક પલાળો.

recipe.name: Poha Dosa
steps: Whisk the fresh curd with the measured drinking water to make a thin buttermilk. Rinse the idli rice, thick poha and split urad dal in a sieve, drain, then cover them with the buttermilk in a deep bowl.

Soak for 2–3 hours until the rice can be broken between your fingers. Drain the mixture, reserving all the soaking liquid. Blend the grains with that liquid in batches to a smooth, moderately thick batter.

Transfer to a roomy clean vessel and stir in the salt. Cover loosely and leave in a warm place for 4–6 hours until the batter looks bubbly and smells pleasantly fermented. Do not use it if it smells rotten or shows discoloration.

Heat a seasoned griddle over medium heat and brush it with a little measured oil. Pour a small ladle of batter and spread gently into a slightly thick circle; do not press out the bubbles. Drizzle a little oil around the edge.

Cover and cook for 2–3 minutes until the underside is lightly golden and the top is set but still soft and porous. Flip for about 30 seconds only if the top needs it. Repeat with the remaining batter and oil, serving two warm dosas per person.
tips: The fermented poha-and-rice batter should make tender, porous dosas rather than crisp paper dosas. The tomato chutney shown in the photo is an optional side, not part of this measured recipe.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak for 2–3 hours, then ferment the batter for 4–6 hours in a warm place.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Whisk the fresh curd with the measured d: ताज़े दही को नापे हुए पीने के पानी के साथ फेंटकर पतली छाछ बनाएँ। इडली चावल, मोटा पोहा और उड़द दाल को छलनी में धोकर छानें, फिर गहरे कटोरे में छाछ से ढक दें।
hi.Soak for 2–3 hours until the rice can be: 2–3 घंटे भिगोएँ, जब तक चावल का दाना उँगलियों के बीच टूटे। मिश्रण छानें और भिगोने का सारा तरल बचाएँ। दानों को उसी तरल के साथ थोड़ी-थोड़ी मात्रा में पीसकर चिकना, मध्यम गाढ़ा घोल बनाएँ।
hi.Transfer to a roomy clean vessel and sti: बड़े साफ बर्तन में डालकर नमक मिलाएँ। ढीला ढककर गरम जगह पर 4–6 घंटे रखें, जब तक बुलबुले दिखें और अच्छी खमीर की गंध आए। सड़ी गंध या बदला रंग दिखे तो इस्तेमाल न करें।
hi.Heat a seasoned griddle over medium heat: तैयार तवा मध्यम आँच पर गरम करके थोड़ा नापा तेल लगाएँ। छोटी करछुल घोल डालकर हल्के से थोड़ा मोटा गोल फैलाएँ; बुलबुले दबाएँ नहीं। किनारे पर थोड़ा तेल डालें।
hi.Cover and cook for 2–3 minutes until the: ढककर 2–3 मिनट पकाएँ जब तक नीचे हल्का सुनहरा और ऊपर से पका पर नरम व झरझरा रहे। ऊपर जरूरत हो तो ही पलटकर लगभग 30 सेकंड पकाएँ। बचे घोल और तेल से इसी तरह बनाएँ और प्रति व्यक्ति दो गरम डोसे परोसें।
hi.The fermented poha-and-rice batter shoul: खमीर उठे पोहा-चावल के घोल से नरम, छेददार डोसे बनने चाहिए, कागज़ जैसे कुरकुरे नहीं। फोटो की टमाटर चटनी वैकल्पिक साथ है, इस नापी हुई रेसिपी का हिस्सा नहीं।
hi.Soak for 2–3 hours, then ferment the bat: 2–3 घंटे भिगोएँ, फिर घोल को गरम जगह पर 4–6 घंटे खमीर उठने दें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Whisk the fresh curd with the measured d: તાજા દહીંને માપેલા પીવાના પાણી સાથે ફેંટીને પાતળી છાશ બનાવો. ઇડલીના ચોખા, જાડા પૌંઆ અને અડદની દાળને ચાળણીમાં ધોઈ નિતારો, પછી ઊંડી વાટકામાં છાશથી ઢાંકો.
gu.Soak for 2–3 hours until the rice can be: 2–3 કલાક પલાળો, ચોખાનો દાણો આંગળીઓ વચ્ચે તૂટે ત્યાં સુધી. મિશ્રણ નિતારી પલાળેલું બધું પ્રવાહી સાચવો. દાણાને એ જ પ્રવાહી સાથે થોડા-થોડા પીસીને સરસ, મધ્યમ ઘટ્ટ ખીરું બનાવો.
gu.Transfer to a roomy clean vessel and sti: મોટા સ્વચ્છ વાસણમાં રેડી મીઠું ભેળવો. ઢીલું ઢાંકી ગરમ જગ્યાએ 4–6 કલાક મૂકો, પરપોટા દેખાય અને સારા આથાની સુગંધ આવે ત્યાં સુધી. સડેલી વાસ કે બદલાયેલો રંગ હોય તો વાપરશો નહીં.
gu.Heat a seasoned griddle over medium heat: તૈયાર તવો મધ્યમ તાપે ગરમ કરી થોડું માપેલું તેલ લગાવો. નાનો ચમચો ખીરું રેડી હળવેથી થોડો જાડો ગોળ ઢોસો ફેલાવો; પરપોટા દબાવો નહીં. કિનારે થોડું તેલ નાખો.
gu.Cover and cook for 2–3 minutes until the: ઢાંકીને 2–3 મિનિટ શેકો, નીચે આછો સોનેરી અને ઉપરથી શેકાયેલો પણ નરમ અને છિદ્રાળુ રહે ત્યાં સુધી. ઉપર જરૂર હોય તો જ ફેરવી આશરે 30 સેકંડ શેકો. બાકી ખીરું અને તેલથી આમ જ બનાવો અને વ્યક્તિ દીઠ બે ગરમ ઢોસા પીરસો.
gu.The fermented poha-and-rice batter shoul: આથો આવેલા પૌંઆ-ચોખાના ખીરાથી નરમ, છિદ્રાળુ ઢોસા બનવા જોઈએ, કાગળ જેવા કરકરા નહીં. ફોટાની ટામેટાની ચટણી વૈકલ્પિક છે, આ માપેલી રેસિપીનો ભાગ નથી.
gu.Soak for 2–3 hours, then ferment the bat: 2–3 કલાક પલાળો, પછી ખીરાને ગરમ જગ્યાએ 4–6 કલાક આથો આવવા દો.

recipe.name: Jolada Dosa
steps: Whisk the jowar flour, rice flour and coarse semolina in a large bowl. Stir in the curd and measured water gradually, breaking up every lump, until the batter is thin and pourable like rava dosa batter.

Finely chop the onion, green chilli, ginger, curry leaves and coriander. Stir them into the batter with cumin and salt. Rest for 10 minutes so the semolina hydrates, then whisk again; add a small splash of water only if it has become too thick to pour.

Heat a flat griddle over medium-high heat. Brush with a little of the measured oil. Stir the batter before each dosa because the flour settles; pour it from the outer edge towards the middle, leaving small lacy gaps rather than spreading it with a spoon.

Drizzle a little oil around the edge and cook for 3–4 minutes until the underside is golden, the top has dried and the dosa releases easily. Fold without flipping; if the centre remains wet, cover briefly before lifting.
Repeat with the remaining batter and oil, keeping the pan hot and stirring the batter each time. Serve the thin sorghum dosas immediately while their edges are crisp.
tips: This instant batter needs no grinding or overnight fermentation. Sorghum flour settles quickly, so stir before every pour.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the mixed batter for 10 minutes; no fermentation is needed.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Whisk the jowar flour, rice flour and co: बड़े कटोरे में ज्वार, चावल का आटा और दरदरी सूजी फेंटकर मिलाएँ। दही और नापा हुआ पानी धीरे-धीरे डालें, सभी गुठलियाँ तोड़ें, जब तक रवा डोसे जैसा पतला बहने वाला घोल बने।
hi.Finely chop the onion, green chilli, gin: प्याज, हरी मिर्च, अदरक, कड़ी पत्ते और धनिया बारीक काटें। जीरे और नमक के साथ घोल में मिलाएँ। सूजी पानी सोख ले इसलिए 10 मिनट रखें, फिर फेंटें; बहुत गाढ़ा हो तो थोड़ा पानी मिलाएँ।
hi.Heat a flat griddle over medium-high hea: चपटा तवा मध्यम-तेज़ आँच पर गरम कर थोड़ा नापा हुआ तेल लगाएँ। हर डोसे से पहले घोल चलाएँ क्योंकि आटा नीचे बैठता है। घोल बाहर से बीच की ओर डालें, छोटे जालीदार खाली स्थान रहने दें; चम्मच से न फैलाएँ।
hi.Drizzle a little oil around the edge and: किनारे पर थोड़ा तेल डालकर 3–4 मिनट पकाएँ, जब तक नीचे सुनहरा हो, ऊपर सूख जाए और डोसा आसानी से उठे। बिना पलटे मोड़ें; बीच गीला हो तो उठाने से पहले थोड़ी देर ढकें।
hi.Repeat with the remaining batter and oil: बचे घोल और तेल से इसी तरह डोसे बनाएँ, तवा गरम रखें और हर बार घोल चलाएँ। ज्वार के पतले डोसे किनारे कुरकुरे रहते ही तुरंत परोसें।
hi.This instant batter needs no grinding or: यह झटपट घोल पीसने या रातभर खमीर उठाने के बिना बनता है। ज्वार का आटा जल्दी नीचे बैठता है, इसलिए हर बार डालने से पहले चलाएँ।
hi.Rest the mixed batter for 10 minutes; no: मिला हुआ घोल 10 मिनट रखें; खमीर उठाने की जरूरत नहीं है।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Whisk the jowar flour, rice flour and co: મોટી વાટકામાં જુવારનો લોટ, ચોખાનો લોટ અને જાડો રવો ભેળવો. દહીં અને માપેલું પાણી ધીમે-ધીમે ઉમેરતા બધી ગાંઠો તોડો, રવા ઢોસા જેવું પાતળું રેડી શકાય એવું ખીરું બને ત્યાં સુધી.
gu.Finely chop the onion, green chilli, gin: ડુંગળી, લીલું મરચું, આદુ, મીઠા લીમડાના પાન અને કોથમીર ઝીણાં સમારો. જીરું અને મીઠા સાથે ખીરામાં ભેળવો. રવો પાણી શોષે તેથી 10 મિનિટ રાખી ફરી હલાવો; વધારે ઘટ્ટ હોય તો થોડું પાણી ઉમેરો.
gu.Heat a flat griddle over medium-high hea: સપાટ તવો મધ્યમથી વધુ તાપે ગરમ કરી થોડું માપેલું તેલ લગાવો. દરેક ઢોસા પહેલાં ખીરું હલાવો કારણ કે લોટ નીચે બેસે છે. બહારની કિનારીથી મધ્ય તરફ ખીરું રેડો, નાના જાળીદાર ખાડા રહેવા દો; ચમચીથી ન ફેલાવો.
gu.Drizzle a little oil around the edge and: કિનારે થોડું તેલ નાખી 3–4 મિનિટ શેકો, નીચે સોનેરી થાય, ઉપરથી સુકાય અને ઢોસો સહેલાઈથી ઊખડે ત્યાં સુધી. ફેરવ્યા વગર વાળો; મધ્યમાં ભીનાશ હોય તો ઊંચકતાં પહેલાં થોડીવાર ઢાંકો.
gu.Repeat with the remaining batter and oil: બાકી ખીરું અને તેલથી આમ જ ઢોસા બનાવો, તવો ગરમ રાખો અને દરેક વખતે ખીરું હલાવો. જુવારના પાતળા ઢોસાની કિનારી કરકરી હોય ત્યારે તરત પીરસો.
gu.This instant batter needs no grinding or: આ ઝડપી ખીરાને પીસવાની કે રાતભર આથો લાવવાની જરૂર નથી. જુવારનો લોટ ઝડપથી નીચે બેસે છે, એટલે દરેક વખતે રેડતાં પહેલાં હલાવો.
gu.Rest the mixed batter for 10 minutes; no: ભેળવેલું ખીરું 10 મિનિટ રાખો; આથો લાવવાની જરૂર નથી.

recipe.name: Moong Dal Idli
steps: Rinse the yellow moong dal until the water runs mostly clear. Cover with plenty of fresh water for 2 hours, then drain very well. Blend with the measured curd, ginger, green chilli and only enough of the measured drinking water to make a thick, smooth batter.

Heat 10 ml of the oil in a small pan. Let the mustard seeds pop, then briefly sizzle the curry leaves. Fold this tempering and the salt into the dal batter. Bring water to a steady boil in an idli steamer and lightly grease twelve moulds with the remaining oil.

Just before steaming, mix the baking soda and lemon juice into the batter; it should foam lightly. Spoon the batter promptly into the prepared moulds, filling each about three-quarters full. Do not leave the aerated batter waiting on the counter.

Steam covered over medium heat for 12–15 minutes. Insert a skewer into the centre of a thick idli; it should come out clean with no wet raw batter. Turn off the heat and rest the steamer for 3 minutes before loosening the idlis.
Serve three warm moong dal idlis per person. Refrigerate leftovers promptly and re-steam until hot rather than leaving cooked idlis at room temperature.
tips: The batter must be thick enough to hold the gas from lemon and soda. Add the leavening only when the steamer is already boiling.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak yellow moong dal for 2 hours.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Rinse the yellow moong dal until the wat: पीली मूंग दाल को पानी लगभग साफ होने तक धोएँ। भरपूर ताज़े पानी में 2 घंटे भिगोकर अच्छी तरह छानें। नापे हुए दही, अदरक, हरी मिर्च और नापे हुए पीने के पानी में से बस आवश्यक मात्रा के साथ पीसकर गाढ़ा चिकना घोल बनाएँ।
hi.Heat 10 ml of the oil in a small pan. Le: छोटे पैन में 10 मिली तेल गरम करें। राई चटकाएँ और कड़ी पत्ते थोड़ी देर भूनें। यह तड़का और नमक दाल के घोल में मिलाएँ। इडली स्टीमर का पानी लगातार उबालें और बचा तेल लगाकर बारह साँचे हल्के चिकने करें।
hi.Just before steaming, mix the baking sod: भाप में रखने से ठीक पहले खाने का सोडा और नींबू रस घोल में मिलाएँ; हल्का झाग उठेगा। तुरंत तैयार साँचों में घोल लगभग तीन-चौथाई भरें। हवा भरे घोल को काउंटर पर इंतज़ार न कराएँ।
hi.Steam covered over medium heat for 12–15: ढककर मध्यम आँच पर 12–15 मिनट भाप में पकाएँ। मोटी इडली के बीच में सींक डालें; गीला कच्चा घोल चिपके बिना साफ निकले। आँच बंद कर 3 मिनट रखें, फिर इडली निकालें।
hi.Serve three warm moong dal idlis per per: प्रति व्यक्ति तीन गरम मूंग दाल इडली परोसें। बची इडली तुरंत फ्रिज में रखें और कमरे के तापमान पर छोड़ने के बजाय दोबारा गरम भाप में पकाएँ।
hi.The batter must be thick enough to hold: घोल इतना गाढ़ा हो कि नींबू और सोडे से बनी हवा थाम सके। स्टीमर का पानी उबलने लगे तभी फुलाने वाली सामग्री डालें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Rinse the yellow moong dal until the wat: પીળી મગની દાળને પાણી લગભગ સ્વચ્છ થાય ત્યાં સુધી ધોવો. પુષ્કળ તાજા પાણીમાં 2 કલાક પલાળી સારી રીતે નિતારો. માપેલા દહીં, આદુ, લીલા મરચાં અને માપેલા પીવાના પાણીમાંથી ફક્ત જરૂરી પાણી સાથે પીસીને ઘટ્ટ સરસ ખીરું બનાવો.
gu.Heat 10 ml of the oil in a small pan. Le: નાના પેનમાં 10 મિલી તેલ ગરમ કરો. રાઈ તતડાવો અને મીઠા લીમડાના પાન થોડું સાંતળો. આ વઘાર અને મીઠું દાળના ખીરામાં ભેળવો. ઇડલીના વાસણમાં પાણી સતત ઉકળવા દો અને બાકી તેલ લગાવી બાર સાંચા હળવા ચીકણા કરો.
gu.Just before steaming, mix the baking sod: વરાળમાં મૂકતાં પહેલાં જ ખાવાનો સોડા અને લીંબુનો રસ ખીરામાં ભેળવો; થોડો ફીણ આવશે. તરત તૈયાર સાંચા લગભગ ત્રણ-ચોથા ભરો. હવા ભરેલું ખીરું બહાર રાહ જોવા ન દો.
gu.Steam covered over medium heat for 12–15: ઢાંકીને મધ્યમ તાપે 12–15 મિનિટ વરાળમાં રાંધો. જાડી ઇડલીના મધ્યમાં સળી નાખો; ભીનું કાચું ખીરું ચોંટ્યા વગર સ્વચ્છ નીકળવી જોઈએ. તાપ બંધ કરી 3 મિનિટ રાખો, પછી ઇડલી કાઢો.
gu.Serve three warm moong dal idlis per per: વ્યક્તિ દીઠ ત્રણ ગરમ મગની દાળ ઇડલી પીરસો. વધેલી ઇડલી તરત ફ્રિજમાં રાખો અને ઓરડાના તાપે મૂકવાને બદલે ફરી ગરમ વરાળમાં શેકો.
gu.The batter must be thick enough to hold: ખીરું એટલું ઘટ્ટ હોવું જોઈએ કે લીંબુ અને સોડાથી બનેલી હવા ટકી રહે. સ्टीમરનું પાણી ઉકળે ત્યારે જ ફુલાવનાર સામગ્રી નાખો.

recipe.name: Cabbage Paratha
steps: Mix the whole wheat flour with 4 g salt and 10 ml oil. Add the measured water gradually and knead for 6–7 minutes into a smooth, pliable dough. Cover and rest for 20 minutes while making the filling.
Grate the cabbage finely, toss with 3 g salt and leave for 10 minutes. Squeeze out its liquid firmly so the filling will not tear the dough. Finely chop the green chilli, ginger and coriander.

Heat 10 ml oil in a pan and briefly toast the cumin. Add the squeezed cabbage, chilli, ginger and turmeric; cook for 4–5 minutes until the raw cabbage smell fades and the pan looks dry. Turn off the heat, stir in dry mango powder, coriander and remaining 3 g salt, then cool completely.

Divide the dough and filling into eight portions. Roll each dough ball into a small disc, put one portion of cool filling in the middle, pinch the edges closed and gently flatten. Dust with a little of the measured flour if needed, then roll to about 15 cm without exposing the filling.

Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat. Cook a paratha until small spots appear, flip, brush with some of the remaining oil and cook until golden patches form. Flip again, brush the other side and press the edges so the wheat dough cooks all the way through.
Cook the remaining parathas with the remaining oil. Serve two hot parathas per person; cut one open to verify the cabbage filling is warm and the inner dough is not raw.
tips: Drying and cooling the cabbage filling prevents torn, soggy parathas. The plain curd in the photo is an optional accompaniment, not part of the measured recipe.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the wheat dough for 20 minutes.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Mix the whole wheat flour with 4 g salt: साबुत गेहूँ के आटे में 4 ग्राम नमक और 10 मिली तेल मिलाएँ। नापा हुआ पानी धीरे-धीरे डालकर 6–7 मिनट गूँधें, चिकना नरम आटा बने। ढककर 20 मिनट रखें और इस बीच भरावन बनाएँ।
hi.Grate the cabbage finely, toss with 3 g: पत्ता गोभी बारीक कसें, 3 ग्राम नमक मिलाकर 10 मिनट रखें। उसका पानी मजबूती से निचोड़ें ताकि भरावन आटा न फाड़े। हरी मिर्च, अदरक और हरा धनिया बारीक काटें।
hi.Heat 10 ml oil in a pan and briefly toas: पैन में 10 मिली तेल गरम करके जीरा थोड़ी देर भूनें। निचोड़ी गोभी, मिर्च, अदरक और हल्दी डालकर 4–5 मिनट पकाएँ, कच्ची गंध जाए और पैन सूखा लगे तब तक। आँच बंद करके अमचूर, धनिया और बचा 3 ग्राम नमक मिलाएँ; पूरी तरह ठंडा करें।
hi.Divide the dough and filling into eight: आटे और भरावन के आठ-आठ हिस्से करें। हर आटे की लोई छोटी बेलकर बीच में ठंडी भरावन रखें, किनारे बंद करके हल्के से दबाएँ। जरूरत हो तो नापे आटे में से थोड़ा छिड़ककर लगभग 15 सेमी बेलें, भरावन बाहर न निकले।
hi.Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat. C: भारी तवा मध्यम आँच पर गरम करें। पराठे पर छोटे धब्बे आने तक सेकें, पलटें, बचे तेल में से थोड़ा लगाकर सुनहरे धब्बे आने तक पकाएँ। फिर पलटकर दूसरी ओर तेल लगाएँ और किनारे दबाएँ ताकि आटा अंदर तक पक जाए।
hi.Cook the remaining parathas with the rem: बचे पराठे बचे तेल से सेकें। प्रति व्यक्ति दो गरम पराठे परोसें; एक काटकर जाँचें कि गोभी गरम और अंदर का आटा कच्चा न हो।
hi.Drying and cooling the cabbage filling p: गोभी की भरावन सूखी और ठंडी रखने से पराठा फटता या गीला नहीं होता। फोटो में सादा दही केवल वैकल्पिक साथ है, नापी हुई रेसिपी का हिस्सा नहीं।
गेहूँ का आटा गूँधकर 20 मिनट रखें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Mix the whole wheat flour with 4 g salt: આખા ઘઉંના લોટમાં 4 ગ્રામ મીઠું અને 10 મિલી તેલ ભેળવો. માપેલું પાણી ધીમે-ધીમે ઉમેરી 6–7 મિનિટ બાંધી સરસ નરમ લોટ બનાવો. ઢાંકીને 20 મિનિટ રાખો અને તે દરમિયાન પૂરણ બનાવો.
gu.Grate the cabbage finely, toss with 3 g: કોબી ઝીણી છીણી 3 ગ્રામ મીઠું ભેળવી 10 મિનિટ રાખો. તેનું પાણી બરાબર નીચોવો જેથી પૂરણ લોટને ફાડે નહીં. લીલું મરચું, આદુ અને કોથમીર ઝીણાં સમારો.
gu.Heat 10 ml oil in a pan and briefly toas: પેનમાં 10 મિલી તેલ ગરમ કરી જીરું થોડું શેકો. નીચોવેલી કોબી, મરચું, આદુ અને હળદર નાખી 4–5 મિનિટ રાંધો, કાચી વાસ જાય અને પેન સૂકું લાગે ત્યાં સુધી. તાપ બંધ કરી આમચૂર, કોથમીર અને બાકી 3 ગ્રામ મીઠું ભેળવો; સંપૂર્ણ ઠંડું કરો.
gu.Divide the dough and filling into eight: લોટ અને પૂરણના આઠ-આઠ ભાગ કરો. દરેક લૂવો નાનો વણી વચ્ચે ઠંડું પૂરણ મૂકો, કિનારી બંધ કરી હળવેથી દબાવો. જરૂર પડે તો માપેલા લોટમાંથી થોડો છાંટી આશરે 15 સેમી વણો, પૂરણ બહાર ન નીકળે.
gu.Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat. C: ભારે તવો મધ્યમ તાપે ગરમ કરો. પરાઠા પર નાના ડાઘ પડે ત્યાં સુધી શેકો, ફેરવો, બાકી તેલમાંથી થોડું લગાવી સોનેરી ડાઘ પડે ત્યાં સુધી શેકો. ફરી ફેરવી બીજી બાજુ તેલ લગાવો અને કિનારી દબાવો જેથી લોટ અંદર સુધી શેકાય.
gu.Cook the remaining parathas with the rem: બાકીના પરાઠા બાકી તેલથી શેકો. વ્યક્તિ દીઠ બે ગરમ પરાઠા પીરસો; એક કાપીને તપાસો કે કોબી ગરમ અને અંદરનો લોટ કાચો ન હોય.
gu.Drying and cooling the cabbage filling p: કોબીનું પૂરણ સૂકું અને ઠંડું રાખવાથી પરાઠા ફાટતા કે ભીના થતા નથી. ફોટામાં સાદું દહીં ફક્ત વૈકલ્પિક સાથે પીરસવાનું છે, માપેલી રેસિપીનો ભાગ નથી.

recipe.name: Rajgira Paratha
steps: Boil the whole potatoes in a separate pan until a knife passes through the middle, about 20–25 minutes. Drain, cool enough to handle, peel and mash until smooth with no large lumps. The potatoes must not be watery.

Mix the rajgira flour, mashed potato, finely chopped green chilli, cumin, coriander and rock salt. Knead gently, adding the measured water a spoonful at a time only as needed, until the mixture holds together as a soft dough.

Divide the dough into eight balls. Flatten each between two sheets of baking parchment lightly greased with the measured ghee into a circle about 12 cm wide; rajgira contains no gluten, so pressing is safer than rolling hard. Peel away the upper sheet.

Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat. Invert one flatbread onto it, remove the remaining sheet and cook until the surface begins to dry. Turn carefully, brush with a little measured ghee and cook for 2–3 minutes until browned patches appear.

Brush the other side with ghee and cook until both faces are firm and the potato-amaranth centre is hot, not sticky. Repeat with the remaining dough and ghee. Serve two warm parathas per person; fasting rules vary by household, so check every ingredient against the household's own practice.
tips: Use genuine rajgira flour, not wheat flour. If the dough cracks, add a little of the measured water and press between parchment instead of stretching it.
recipe.passiveTime: Allow the boiled potato to cool before making the dough.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Boil the whole potatoes in a separate pa: साबुत आलू अलग पैन में लगभग 20–25 मिनट उबालें, जब तक चाकू बीच से आसानी से निकल जाए। पानी निकालें, हाथ से संभालने लायक ठंडा करें, छीलें और बड़े टुकड़े न रहें तब तक मसलें। आलू गीले नहीं होने चाहिए।
hi.Mix the rajgira flour, mashed potato, fi: राजगिरा आटा, मसले आलू, बारीक कटी हरी मिर्च, जीरा, धनिया और सेंधा नमक मिलाएँ। नापा हुआ पानी केवल जरूरत के अनुसार चम्मच-चम्मच डालकर हल्के से गूँधें, जब तक नरम आटा एक साथ बँध जाए।
hi.Divide the dough into eight balls. Flatt: आटे की आठ लोइयाँ बनाएँ। हर लोई को नापे घी से हल्के चिकने किए बेकिंग कागज़ की दो चादरों के बीच लगभग 12 सेमी गोल दबाएँ। राजगिरा में ग्लूटेन नहीं होता, इसलिए जोर से बेलने से बेहतर दबाना है। ऊपर का कागज़ हटाएँ।
hi.Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat. I: भारी तवा मध्यम आँच पर गरम करें। एक पराठा उस पर उलटकर रखें, दूसरा कागज़ हटाएँ और सतह सूखने तक सेकें। सावधानी से पलटें, थोड़ा नापा घी लगाएँ और 2–3 मिनट सुनहरे धब्बे आने तक पकाएँ।
hi.Brush the other side with ghee and cook: दूसरी ओर भी घी लगाकर सेकें, जब तक दोनों तरफ पराठा पक्का और आलू-राजगिरा का बीच गरम हो, चिपचिपा न रहे। बचे आटे और घी से ऐसे ही बनाएँ। प्रति व्यक्ति दो गरम पराठे परोसें; उपवास के नियम घर-घर बदलते हैं, इसलिए हर सामग्री अपने घर की प्रथा से जाँचें।
hi.Use genuine rajgira flour, not wheat flo: असली राजगिरा आटा लें, गेहूँ का नहीं। आटा फटे तो नापे पानी में से थोड़ा मिलाकर कागज़ के बीच दबाएँ, खींचें नहीं।
hi.Allow the boiled potato to cool before m: आटा बनाने से पहले उबले आलू को ठंडा होने दें।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Boil the whole potatoes in a separate pa: આખા બટાકા અલગ પેનમાં આશરે 20–25 મિનિટ બાફો, મધ્યમાંથી છરી સહેલાઈથી પસાર થાય ત્યાં સુધી. પાણી કાઢી હાથથી પકડી શકાય એટલા ઠંડા કરો, છોલી મોટી ગાંઠ ન રહે એમ મસળો. બટાકા પાણીવાળા ન હોવા જોઈએ.
gu.Mix the rajgira flour, mashed potato, fi: રાજગરાનો લોટ, મસળેલા બટાકા, ઝીણું સમારેલું લીલું મરચું, જીરું, કોથમીર અને સિંધવ મીઠું ભેળવો. માપેલું પાણી ફક્ત જરૂર પ્રમાણે ચમચી-ચમચી ઉમેરી હળવેથી બાંધો, નરમ લોટ ભેગો થાય ત્યાં સુધી.
gu.Divide the dough into eight balls. Flatt: લોટના આઠ લૂવા બનાવો. દરેકને માપેલા ઘીથી હળવા ચીકણા કરેલા બેકિંગ કાગળની બે ચાદર વચ્ચે આશરે 12 સેમી ગોળ દબાવો. રાજગરામાં ગ્લૂટેન નથી, તેથી જોરથી વણવા કરતાં દબાવવું સારું. ઉપરનો કાગળ કાઢો.
gu.Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat. I: ભારે તવો મધ્યમ તાપે ગરમ કરો. એક પરાઠો તેના પર ઊંધો મૂકી બીજો કાગળ કાઢો અને સપાટી સૂકાય ત્યાં સુધી શેકો. કાળજીથી ફેરવી થોડું માપેલું ઘી લગાવો અને 2–3 મિનિટ સોનેરી ડાઘ પડે ત્યાં સુધી શેકો.
gu.Brush the other side with ghee and cook: બીજી બાજુ પણ ઘી લગાવી શેકો, બંને બાજુ પાકી અને બટાકા-રાજગરાનું મધ્ય ગરમ થાય, ચીકણું ન રહે ત્યાં સુધી. બાકી લોટ અને ઘીથી આમ જ બનાવો. વ્યક્તિ દીઠ બે ગરમ પરાઠા પીરસો; ઉપવાસના નિયમો ઘરે ઘરે બદલાય છે, એટલે દરેક સામગ્રી પોતાના ઘરની પ્રથા મુજબ તપાસો.
gu.Use genuine rajgira flour, not wheat flo: અસલી રાજગરાનો લોટ લો, ઘઉંનો નહીં. લોટ તૂટે તો માપેલા પાણીમાંથી થોડું ઉમેરી કાગળ વચ્ચે દબાવો, ખેંચશો નહીં.
gu.Allow the boiled potato to cool before m: લોટ બાંધતાં પહેલાં બાફેલા બટાકા ઠંડા થવા દો.

recipe.name: Amaranth Porridge
steps: Rinse the whole amaranth seeds in a very fine sieve so none are lost. Put them in a heavy saucepan with the measured drinking water and half the milk. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a low simmer.

Cover partly and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring every few minutes and scraping the base. The tiny grains should be tender through the centre and suspended in a creamy porridge, not crunchy. Add a splash of the remaining measured milk if the pan begins to dry.

Stir in the ground cinnamon and most of the remaining milk, simmering for 2–3 minutes to reach a spoonable consistency. Turn off the heat; the porridge thickens as it stands, so reserve a little milk for the final adjustment.

Slice the banana and chop the almonds. Divide the hot porridge among four bowls, loosen with the reserved milk, and top each with banana, berries and almonds. Drizzle the measured maple syrup evenly over the bowls and serve while warm.
tips: Use whole amaranth seeds rather than popped amaranth in this version. Stir often near the end because milk-rich porridge can catch on the pan.

recipe.name: Oats Pancakes
steps: Whisk the oat flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a large bowl. In a separate bowl whisk the milk, curd and vanilla until smooth, then pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and fold just until no flour pockets remain.

Leave the batter for 10 minutes so the oat flour absorbs moisture. It should be thick but drop from a spoon; if it becomes stiff, mix in a small splash of water. Avoid beating it after the rest or the pancakes may become heavy.

Heat a non-stick or well-seasoned griddle over medium-low heat. Brush with a little of the measured oil and pour about one-eighth of the batter for each pancake, leaving room for it to spread into a small round.

Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles appear and the edges look set. Turn gently and cook for another 1–2 minutes until the centre springs back and there is no wet batter. Repeat with the remaining batter and oil, lowering the heat if the surface darkens too quickly.
Stack two warm pancakes per person. Divide the washed berries over the four plates and drizzle the measured maple syrup evenly over them. Serve promptly while the pancakes are fluffy.
tips: Oat flour absorbs liquid as it rests, so judge batter thickness just before cooking. Use fresh baking powder for a light texture.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the batter for 10 minutes so the oat flour hydrates.

recipe.name: Trini Doubles
steps: Soak the chickpeas overnight, drain, then simmer in fresh water until very tender, about 50–70 minutes. Reserve 300 ml of their cooking liquid.
Mix flour, yeast, turmeric and 4 g salt. Add 235 ml water and knead into a soft tacky dough. Cover and rest for 30 minutes, then divide into 16 small balls.
Blend coriander and green chilli with a little water into a spoonable green sauce. Loosen the tamarind pulp with warm water to make a thin tangy sauce.

Heat 20 ml oil in a pan. Soften the chopped onion and garlic, stir in cumin and curry powder, then add cooked chickpeas, reserved liquid and remaining salt. Simmer until the channa is saucy; lightly mash some chickpeas.
Oil fingertips, stretch each dough ball into a thin small round, and fry in the remaining oil over medium heat for roughly 40 seconds per side, until puffed and just golden. Drain briefly.
Place one warm bara under a second, spoon channa between them and finish with a little tamarind and green sauce. Make eight doubles and serve immediately while the bara stays soft.
tips: Keep the fried bara pale and soft; crisp bread will not fold around the channa.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the bara dough for 30 minutes.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

મેંદો, યીસ્ટ, હળદર અને 4 ગ્રામ મીઠું ભેળવો. 235 મિલી પાણી નાખી નરમ ચીકણો લોટ બાંધો. ઢાંકી 30 મિનિટ રાખી 16 નાની લૂઈ બનાવો.

recipe.name: Cuscuz Nordestino
steps: Mix the coarse flaked cornmeal and salt in a bowl. Sprinkle in the water gradually, rubbing through the grains with fingertips so all are moist but not submerged.
Cover the moistened grains and leave for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and break any large lumps; the grains should hold together lightly when squeezed.
Fill the bottom of a couscous steamer with water. Loosely spoon the hydrated cornmeal into its perforated upper basket without pressing it down, leaving room for steam to circulate.
Cover and steam over steadily simmering water for about 15 minutes, until the grains are tender and the top is hot throughout. Add water below if the pan dries; do not let the meal touch the water.
Turn the cuscuz out onto a plate or divide into four small domes. Top each with a little butter and crumbled fresh white cheese, letting the butter melt into the hot grains. Serve warm.
tips: Use flocão or another coarse pre-flaked cornmeal; fine corn flour becomes pasty.
recipe.passiveTime: Hydrate the cornmeal for 10 minutes before steaming.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

hi.Cover and steam over steadily simmering: ढककर लगातार उबलते पानी की भाप में लगभग 15 मिनट पकाएँ, जब तक दाने नरम और ऊपर तक गरम हों। नीचे पानी कम हो तो बढ़ाएँ; मिश्रण पानी से न छुए।

recipe.name: Adasi
steps: Pick over and rinse the brown lentils; soak for 20 minutes, then drain. Dice the onion finely and crush the garlic.
Heat 20 ml olive oil in a heavy pan. Cook the onion over medium heat for 7–8 minutes until golden at the edges. Stir in garlic, cumin and turmeric for 30 seconds without burning them.

Add drained lentils and the measured water. Bring to a boil, then cover loosely and simmer 25–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft but still visible. Add a little hot water only if the pan is drying.
Mash a few spoonfuls of cooked lentils against the side of the pan to thicken the stew. Add salt and pepper; simmer uncovered for 3–5 minutes until spoonable rather than watery.
Ladle into four bowls. Drizzle the remaining olive oil over the stew, add lemon wedges and serve with flatbread. Let each person squeeze lemon into their warm bowl to taste.
tips: Brown lentils keep their shape and make a hearty Adasi; red split lentils cook into a different texture.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak lentils for 20 minutes while preparing the aromatics.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Natto Gohan
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs nearly clear, then soak it in the measured water for 15 minutes. Cook covered over low heat for about 15 minutes and rest off heat for 10 minutes without lifting the lid.
Open the prepared natto and stir it vigorously with chopsticks or a fork for 30–60 seconds until sticky threads develop and the beans turn creamy.
Mix soy sauce and mustard into the natto. Slice the spring onion thinly; do not heat the natto, which is traditionally added after the rice is cooked.
Fluff the hot rice and divide between four small bowls. Spoon a quarter of the seasoned natto over each bowl and scatter the spring onion on top.
Serve immediately while the rice is hot. Stir the beans through each bowl just before eating so every mouthful has rice and natto.
tips: Check the natto seasoning packet before using it: some prepared sauces contain fish stock; this recipe uses plain soy sauce instead.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak rice for 15 minutes before cooking.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

चावल पकाने से पहले 15 मिनट भिगोएँ।

ચોખા ગરમ હોય ત્યારે તરત પીરસો. ખાતાં પહેલાં દાણા ચોખામાં ભેળવો જેથી દરેક કોળિયામાં બંને આવે.
gu.Check the natto seasoning packet before: તૈયાર નાત્તોની સોસ તપાસો: કેટલીક સોસમાં માછલીનો રસ હોય છે; અહીં સાદો સોયા સોસ લો.

recipe.name: Mandazi
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, cardamom and salt so the raising agent is evenly distributed. Pour in the coconut milk and mix to a soft dough.
Knead briefly until smooth, adding only a dusting of flour if very sticky. Cover and rest for 30 minutes; this makes the dough easier to roll without toughening it.
Roll the dough to about 8 mm thick. Cut into squares, then diagonally into roughly 16 triangles; keep the pieces covered while the oil heats.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to about 170°C. Fry a few triangles at a time for 2–3 minutes per side, turning once, until puffed and evenly golden with no raw centre.
Lift out and drain on a rack or paper. Serve warm; split one to check its breadlike crumb before serving the whole batch.
tips: Keep the oil moderately hot: very hot oil browns the outside before the centre cooks.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the kneaded dough for 30 minutes.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Knead briefly until smooth, adding only: चिकना होने तक थोड़ा गूँधें; बहुत चिपके तभी थोड़ा मैदा छिड़कें। ढककर 30 मिनट रखें ताकि बिना सख्त हुए बेलना आसान हो।

hi.Heat the oil in a deep pan to about 170°: गहरे पैन में तेल लगभग 170°C तक गरम करें। कुछ त्रिकोण एक बार में हर तरफ 2–3 मिनट तलें, एक बार पलटें, जब तक फूले और बराबर सुनहरे हों तथा बीच कच्चा न रहे।

hi.Keep the oil moderately hot: very hot oi: बहुत तेज तेल से बाहर जल्दी भूरा हो जाएगा और बीच कच्चा रह सकता है।

recipe.name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Crumble the paneer into pea-sized pieces with clean fingers. Finely chop onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger and coriander; keep the tomato separate.
Heat oil in a broad pan, add cumin and let it sizzle. Cook the onion over medium heat for 5–6 minutes until soft, then add ginger and green chilli for one minute.
Stir in tomato, turmeric, chilli powder and salt. Cook uncovered for 5–7 minutes until the tomato breaks down and its excess moisture evaporates.
Fold in the crumbled paneer and garam masala. Toss gently for 2–3 minutes until heated through; do not simmer long or the paneer will become rubbery.
Finish with coriander. Toast the pav cut-side down on a dry pan and serve the hot bhurji with bread, dividing it into four portions.
tips: Add paneer only after the tomato mixture has thickened so the bhurji stays crumbly rather than watery.
recipe.passiveTime: No passive preparation required.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Heat oil in a broad pan, add cumin and l: चौड़े पैन में तेल गरम कर जीरा चटकाएँ। प्याज़ मध्यम आँच पर 5–6 मिनट नरम होने तक पकाएँ, फिर अदरक और हरी मिर्च एक मिनट भूनें।
hi.Stir in tomato, turmeric, chilli powder: टमाटर, हल्दी, लाल मिर्च और नमक मिलाएँ। बिना ढके 5–7 मिनट पकाएँ जब तक टमाटर गल जाए और अतिरिक्त पानी सूख जाए।

hi.Finish with coriander. Toast the pav cut: धनिया छिड़कें। कटे पाव का अंदरूनी भाग सूखे तवे पर सेंकें और गरम भुर्जी को चार हिस्सों में बाँटकर परोसें।
hi.Add paneer only after the tomato mixture: टमाटर का मिश्रण गाढ़ा होने पर ही पनीर डालें ताकि भुर्जी दानेदार रहे।

बिना रुके बनाया जा सकता है।

recipe.name: Medu Vada
steps: Wash and soak urad dal for 4 hours, then drain very well. Grind in batches with just enough of the measured water to make a thick smooth batter; too much water stops the vadas holding shape.
Beat the batter by hand for 3–4 minutes to aerate it. Fold in finely chopped onion, chilli, ginger and curry leaves with crushed pepper and salt.
Heat oil in a deep pan to around 175°C. Wet your fingers, shape a small portion of batter into a thick ring with a central hole and slip it carefully into the oil.
Fry in small batches, turning once or twice, for 4–5 minutes until the vadas are deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack; keep the oil temperature steady between batches.
Warm the prepared sambar, portion the coconut chutney, and serve two crisp vadas per person immediately with both accompaniments.
tips: If a spoonful of batter floats in water, it has enough air for light vadas.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak the urad dal for 4 hours.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Wash and soak urad dal for 4 hours, then: उड़द दाल धोकर 4 घंटे भिगोएँ, फिर बहुत अच्छी तरह छानें। नापे पानी में से बस जितना चाहिए उतना डालकर गाढ़ा चिकना घोल पीसें; ज्यादा पानी से वड़े आकार नहीं रखेंगे।

hi.If a spoonful of batter floats in water,: एक चम्मच घोल पानी में तैरे तो हल्के वड़ों के लिए पर्याप्त हवा है।

recipe.name: Rava Dosa
steps: Mix semolina, rice flour, plain flour, curd and salt. Whisk in the measured water to make a very thin flowing batter, then add cumin, finely chopped chilli and ginger.
Rest for 20 minutes. Stir well because the semolina settles; add a small splash of water if it has thickened so it pours almost like thin buttermilk.

Heat a well-seasoned flat griddle until a drop of water sizzles. Stir the batter, then splash a ladleful from the outside towards the middle, leaving the characteristic tiny gaps instead of spreading it with the ladle.

Drizzle some of the measured oil into the gaps and around the edge. Cook over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes until the underside is golden and the edges lift; avoid flipping unless the top remains wet.
Fold carefully and serve crisp with the prepared coconut chutney. Stir the batter before every dosa to keep the semolina evenly suspended.
tips: A hot pan and very thin batter produce the lacy gaps that distinguish rava dosa.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the thin batter for 20 minutes.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
steps: Soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek separately for 5 hours. Grind with the soaked poha and enough measured water into a smooth pourable batter. Cover loosely and ferment overnight until bubbly; then stir in half the salt.
For the red chutney, soak dried chillies in hot water and blend with garlic, roasted chana dal and a little of the measured water to a thick spreadable paste.
Heat 20 ml oil, splutter mustard and curry leaves, soften chopped onion, then add turmeric, mashed boiled potato and remaining salt. Cook until the filling is hot and fairly dry.

Spread a ladle of fermented batter thinly on a hot griddle. Drizzle some remaining oil around it, cook until the base turns golden, then smear a thin layer of red chutney and a little butter across the top.

Place potato masala down the middle, fold the dosa around it and cook briefly until crisp. Repeat for four large dosas and serve at once; keep the chutney layer thin so it does not overpower the filling.
tips: The red chutney belongs inside the dosa; apply it only after the underside has set.

recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Set Dosa
steps: Wash and soak the rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Soak the poha briefly, then grind everything with the measured water to a smooth, slightly thick batter.
Cover loosely and ferment overnight until light and bubbly. Add salt gently; do not beat out all the air. The batter should fall slowly from a ladle, unlike thin rava-dosa batter.
Heat a griddle on medium and brush lightly with oil. Pour a small ladleful for each dosa and let it settle into a thick 10–12 cm round without spreading it paper-thin.
Cover for about 2 minutes until many holes form and the top sets. Flip briefly for 30–45 seconds, keeping the dosa pale, soft and spongy; repeat to make twelve small dosas.
Warm the prepared vegetable sagu. Serve three dosas per person with a quarter of the sagu and coconut chutney, while the dosas are still pillowy.
tips: Set dosa should stay thick and soft, with many steam holes; do not flatten it into a crisp plain dosa.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak for 5 hours and ferment the batter overnight.

gu.Set dosa should stay thick and soft, wit: સેટ ડોસો જાડો, નરમ અને વરાળનાં ઘણાં કાણાવાળો રાખો; પાતળો કરકરો ડોસો ન બનાવો.
gu.Soak for 5 hours and ferment the batter: 5 કલાક પલાળી ખીરું રાતભર આથો આવવા દો.

recipe.name: Ghee Roast Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until visibly risen.
Stir in salt without flattening the batter. Heat a broad seasoned griddle; a drop of water should dance and evaporate quickly.
Pour one ladle of batter in the centre and spread in widening circles until almost paper-thin. Spoon about one-eighth of the ghee around the rim and across the surface.
Roast on medium heat until the base turns deep golden and releases cleanly, about 3–4 minutes. For a thin dosa, fold into a triangle or cone without flipping; repeat for eight dosas.
Serve two hot crisp dosas per person with warmed prepared sambar and coconut chutney. Do not stack them, or steam will soften the crust.
tips: Use a broad griddle and spread the batter very thinly; ghee adds flavour but cannot crisp a thick dosa.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak grains for 5 hours and ferment overnight.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Onion Rava Dosa
steps: Whisk semolina, rice flour, plain flour and salt with the measured water into a very thin batter. Add cumin and finely minced ginger; leave it for 20 minutes.
Finely dice onion and green chilli. Stir them into the batter just before cooking, then stir again before each dosa because semolina sinks and onion floats.
Heat a well-seasoned griddle until hot. Splash a ladleful of batter from outside towards the centre, allowing many tiny holes to remain; do not spread it like an ordinary dosa.
Drizzle a little of the measured oil into the holes and around the edges. Cook for 3–4 minutes until crisp and deep golden underneath, loosening the edges carefully.
Fold each dosa and serve at once with prepared coconut chutney. Add a splash of water if the final batter becomes thick; it must flow freely for a lacy crust.
tips: Dice onion very small so pieces adhere to the thin lace instead of tearing it.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the batter for 20 minutes.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Idiyappam
steps: Dry-roast the rice flour for 2 minutes over low heat, stirring continuously, without browning it. Bring measured water, salt and oil to a full boil.
Pour the boiling liquid over the flour and stir firmly until no dry patches remain. Cover for 5 minutes; when safe to handle, knead to a smooth soft dough without cracks.
Fill an idiyappam press fitted with a fine-holed plate. Squeeze thin strands in loose spirals onto lightly oiled steamer plates, making about eight small nests.
Steam over boiling water for 8–10 minutes until the nests are set and no raw flour smell remains. Lift carefully and let them cool for a minute so the strands release cleanly.
Warm the prepared coconut vegetable stew and divide it into four bowls. Serve two white rice-noodle nests per person with stew alongside, keeping the noodles fluffy rather than packed.
tips: The water must be boiling when it meets the flour; lukewarm water makes strands break in the press.
recipe.passiveTime: Rest the hot rice dough covered for 5 minutes.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Puttu
steps: Soak black chickpeas overnight. Drain and pressure-cook or simmer in fresh water until tender, reserving 300 ml cooking liquid for the curry.
Rub the rice flour with half the salt and the measured water little by little until it resembles damp crumbs that hold briefly when squeezed; it must not become a paste.

Layer a little coconut, damp flour and more coconut in a puttu cylinder, keeping the layers loose. Steam over boiling water for 8–10 minutes until steam rises through the top and the flour is cooked; make four cylinders.

For kadala curry, heat oil, soften chopped onion, ginger and garlic, add curry leaves, tomato, coriander, turmeric and garam masala, and cook until tomato breaks down. Add cooked chickpeas and reserved liquid; simmer 10 minutes and season with the remaining salt.
Slide the hot puttu from its mould without compressing it. Divide the chickpea curry into four bowls and serve alongside, breaking the crumbly rice-and-coconut cylinder into the sauce as you eat.
tips: Correctly moistened puttu flour feels sandy, not kneadable like chapati dough.

recipe.name: Indori Poha
steps: Rinse the thick poha briefly in a sieve without soaking it in a bowl. Drain for 10 minutes until the flakes bend without breaking, then gently mix in turmeric, sugar and half the salt.

Heat oil, splutter mustard and soften half the finely chopped onion with green chilli for 3 minutes. Add the seasoned poha and remaining salt, toss gently, then cover and steam on very low heat for 4–5 minutes.
Switch off the heat and fold in lemon juice. Fluff with a fork so the poha stays separate and soft rather than becoming a mashed lump.
Divide into four shallow bowls. Scatter the remaining raw onion, jeeravan, fine sev, pomegranate arils and coriander over each portion in that order.
Serve immediately while the poha is warm and the sev is crisp. Offer extra lemon if desired; add the sev only at the table, never during steaming.
tips: Jeeravan and fine sev give Indori poha its particular tangy-crisp finish.

recipe.name: Paper Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until visibly risen.
Stir in salt without flattening the batter. Heat a broad seasoned griddle; a drop of water should dance and evaporate quickly.

Heat the largest well-seasoned griddle available until a drop of water evaporates at once. Pour a small ladle of batter in the centre and spread in wide, fast concentric circles, making an unusually long, nearly translucent sheet.
Drizzle a little oil over the surface and edge. Cook over medium heat for 3–5 minutes, until the whole underside is crisp golden and its edges lift freely; do not flip or add a filling.
Lift carefully with a long spatula, fold loosely and transfer immediately to a broad plate. Serve with warm sambar and coconut chutney; never stack paper dosas because steam destroys their crispness.
tips: Paper dosa depends on an exceptionally thin spread and a broad hot griddle.

recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Benne Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until visibly risen.
Stir in salt without flattening the batter. Heat a broad seasoned griddle; a drop of water should dance and evaporate quickly.
Mash the boiled potato. Melt 15 g butter in a small pan, splutter mustard, soften chopped onion, then stir in turmeric and potato to make a warm, fairly dry palya.
Heat a griddle on medium. Spread a ladle of fermented batter into a moderately thick round, thinner than a set dosa but thicker than paper dosa. Dot generously with some of the remaining butter.
Cook until the base is golden and the top nearly set, then flip briefly. Serve hot with a spoonful of potato palya, a small pat of remaining butter and coconut chutney; make eight dosas.
tips: Benne means butter; its generous butter and soft-crisp centre distinguish this dosa.

recipe.name: Cheese Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until visibly risen.
Stir in salt without flattening the batter. Heat a broad seasoned griddle; a drop of water should dance and evaporate quickly.
Dice the boiled potato, carrot and capsicum finely. Cook them in 15 ml oil for 4–5 minutes until the carrot softens and the mixture is fairly dry.
Heat a griddle and spread fermented batter into eight medium-thin dosas, using the remaining oil around the edges. Cook each until the underside is golden and the top no longer wet.

Scatter a quarter of the vegetable mixture and grated cheese over each of four large dosas, or half as much over eight small ones. Cover briefly to melt the cheese, fold and serve immediately with coconut chutney.
tips: Add cheese near the end so it melts without scorching on the griddle.

recipe.name: Schezwan Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until visibly risen.
Stir in salt without flattening the batter. Heat a broad seasoned griddle; a drop of water should dance and evaporate quickly.
Shred cabbage, carrot and capsicum into thin strips. Heat 15 ml oil and stir-fry the vegetables over high heat for 3–4 minutes so they stay a little crisp.
Heat a griddle and spread fermented batter into eight medium-thin dosas. Drizzle the remaining oil around each and cook until the underside is golden.
Spread a thin layer of vegetarian Schezwan sauce over the set top, add the hot vegetables and fold. Serve immediately; use a sauce whose label confirms vegetarian ingredients.
tips: Use a confirmed vegetarian sauce: some bottled chilli sauces contain seafood.

recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Jini Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until visibly risen.
Stir in salt without flattening the batter. Heat a broad seasoned griddle; a drop of water should dance and evaporate quickly.
Finely chop cabbage, carrot, capsicum and tomato. Briefly stir-fry them in 15 ml oil so the vegetable mixture is hot but not watery.
Spread fermented batter thinly on a broad hot griddle and drizzle a little of the remaining oil around it. When the surface sets, smear vegetarian chilli sauce across the dosa.

Scatter a quarter of the hot vegetables and cheese over each of four large dosas. Roll tightly while still flexible, let the cheese melt, then cut each roll into upright bite-sized segments and serve at once.
tips: Chop filling finely so the rolled dosa can be sliced without collapsing.

recipe.name: Paneer Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until visibly risen.
Stir in salt without flattening the batter. Heat a broad seasoned griddle; a drop of water should dance and evaporate quickly.
Crumble paneer and finely chop onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander. In 15 ml oil, soften onion, add chilli, turmeric and tomato, and cook until excess tomato liquid evaporates.
Fold in paneer and coriander and heat for 2 minutes without drying it. Spread the fermented batter into eight medium dosas on a hot griddle, adding the remaining oil around the edges.
Cook each dosa until the base is golden and the top set. Spoon paneer filling along the middle, fold and serve immediately with coconut chutney; avoid overcooking the paneer.
tips: Keep the paneer filling moist but not runny, so it stays inside the folded dosa.

recipe.name: Oats Dosa
steps: Whisk oat flour, rice flour, semolina, curd, salt and water into a thin smooth batter. Add cumin, minced ginger and green chilli.
Rest for 15 minutes. Stir again; oats and semolina absorb water, so loosen with a little extra water if the batter no longer pours freely.
Heat a seasoned griddle over medium-high heat. Pour batter from the outside towards the centre, making a thin lacy round; do not press or spread it like a thick pancake.
Drizzle a little measured oil around the edges and cook for 3–4 minutes until the underside is golden and the top dry. Flip for 20–30 seconds only if needed.
Fold and serve immediately with coconut chutney. Stir the batter before every dosa so the oat solids stay evenly distributed.
tips: Use a thin batter; oats thicken rapidly as they sit.

recipe.name: Godhuma Dosa
steps: Whisk whole wheat flour and rice flour with the measured water until smooth and pourable. Mix in cumin, finely chopped chilli, grated ginger and salt.
Leave the batter for 10 minutes, then stir thoroughly. Whole wheat flour settles; keep the mixture as thin as buttermilk by adding a small splash of water if needed.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle. Pour a ladle of batter in a quick circular motion from the edge inward, leaving the small lacy holes that form naturally.
Drizzle a little of the remaining oil around each dosa. Cook over medium heat until the edges are crisp and the underside is brown, 3–4 minutes; flip briefly if the top is still damp.
Fold the hot wheat dosas and serve with coconut chutney. Stir before each pour to keep the flour suspended.
tips: The rice flour helps crisp the otherwise soft whole-wheat batter.

recipe.name: Methi Dosa
steps: Wash rice and urad dal. Soak them with fenugreek seeds for 5 hours, then grind with the measured water to a smooth, slightly thick batter.
Cover loosely and ferment overnight until risen and bubbly. Stir in salt gently; the pronounced fenugreek quantity gives this dosa its distinct aroma.
Heat a flat griddle over medium heat and oil lightly. Pour a ladle of batter and spread into a medium-thick round, leaving enough depth for a soft spongy centre.
Cover for 2 minutes until bubbles form and the top sets. Flip for about 30 seconds, keeping the dosa pale golden rather than roasting it crisp; repeat for eight dosas.
Serve two warm soft methi dosas per person with coconut chutney. Avoid stacking them tightly so steam does not make them gummy.
tips: Use fenugreek seeds, not leaves, in the soaking batter for this version.

recipe.name: Kal Dosa
steps: Wash and soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Grind with the measured water to a smooth thick batter, cover loosely and ferment overnight until light and bubbly.
Stir in salt gently. Heat a thick stone or cast-iron griddle on medium; oil the surface lightly. The griddle should cook slowly and evenly, not scorch the batter.
Pour a ladleful of batter and spread only once into a thick 12–14 cm circle. Leave the middle substantial so it can steam into the soft home-style texture.
Cover and cook 2–3 minutes until the top looks set and the underside is lightly golden. Flip for a further minute; remove while still soft, never dry and brittle.
Serve two hot kal dosas per person with tomato chutney. Keep cooked dosas under a cloth briefly to retain softness.
tips: Kal dosa is deliberately thick and soft, unlike paper dosa.
recipe.passiveTime: Soak rice and dal for 5 hours; ferment overnight.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Thatte Idli
steps: Wash and soak idli rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Soak poha briefly and grind it with the drained grains and measured water into a thick, smooth batter.
Cover loosely and ferment overnight until the batter has visibly risen. Gently fold in salt; avoid beating out the air that makes the large idlis soft.
Lightly oil four wide, flat thatte-idli plates. Pour the batter about 2 cm deep into each, leaving a little room at the rim for expansion.
Steam over actively boiling water for 12–15 minutes, until a skewer inserted at the centre comes out clean. Rest for 2 minutes before lifting each broad idli from its plate.
Serve one plate-sized idli per person with warm prepared sambar and coconut chutney. Its broad, flat shape is the defining feature; do not use small round idli moulds.
tips: The batter should be thick enough to rise, but pourable into a flat plate.

recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
